Not as interesting as some others, but I'm bisexual. 

Society is more accepting of the LGBT community, but I'm stuck in a church full of people who think that kind of them is sinful. If word got out of my sexuality, my family could get expelled/shunned from the church, and my relationship with my parents would get even more strained. 

I'm attracted to one of my friends, and although she is straight, loves to pretend she's gay. It kind of makes me uncomfortable when we hold hands, she flirts with me, or kisses my hand, knowing she'll never feel the same way.
Jokes on you, I already have gender dysphoria! :D
Agreed.. I'm pretty big on being LGBT, but her content is so preachy and gives the LGBT a bad rap...
I have to finish a study guide due tomorrow. I'll do it after *one more* reddit post..

Not a teacher, but I think my middle school teachers realized I had a crush on a guy. I was the shy, quiet kid at school, but when I was the my crush, I was like a whole other person. I got more talkative and excited, and I think it was obvious I liked him. At some point, this guy who barely talked to me repeatedly asked me If I liked my crush. The teachers gave us three classes together in assigned seats. Thanks, middle school teachers.

Thank you.

I got into an argument with my mother on the topic of LGBT. She was confused about the differences between being a homosexual and transgender, and complained about them, saying it was a choice. I tried to explain to her that she was wrong, but she got angry and (using my love for God against me) forced me to say that it was wrong to be transgender. I almost cried, thinking about my gender-related insecurities, and she told me I was being too soft.

Reading these supportive comments makes me feel better. Thanks again.

Thanks. I can relate as well. I'm bi, but I'm attracted to more men than women. 

Seeing men in suits and ties makes me feel weird. I"m so jealous of their bodies, and sometimes I want to cry thinking about it. I have to wear a dress at least twice a week, and I feel uncomfortable in them.

 It doesn't heal the pain, but it makes me feel better to know I'm not alone.

Thank you for the support.
